Question
========
Fit a linear model to the data to see whether life satisfaction is significantly predicted from the type of animal ([how to](https://jasp-stats.github.io/jasp-video-library/All_Regression.html#main-analysis-single-predictor)). What does this regression model predict for a cat owner? Use two decimals.

Answerlist
----------
* Predicted life satisfaction:

Solution
========
In the Coefficients table, the intercept is 38.17 (the mean of the fish group, the reference category) and b for pet (Cat) is 21.96, the difference between the two group means. So the prediction for a cat owner is 38.17 + 21.96 = 60.13, the mean of the cat group.

DSUJ §9.4, p. 371. discoverjasp: [Task 9.6](https://discoverjasp.com/pages/smart_alex.html#task-9.6), [results](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_alex/alex_09_05-06.html).
